For other uses, see Miell (disambiguation).

Miell is a Non-Playable Character (NPC) in the Aimyhr storyline.

sections.title: In-game Appearance
sections.content: Miell is an NPC from the Brave Frontier 2019 Summer Vortex Dungeon. She appears alongside Chryssa and Sennie.

sections.title: General
sections.content: Miell is a half-fawn, half-human female. She refers to herself as the “caretaker” of The Vale. She seems to be very outgoing, and willing to help any creature in need.

sections.title: History
sections.content:
During her general stroll through The Vale, Miell notices Sennie and Chryssa, who seem to be struggling greatly. Upon further inspection, Miell sees that they are stuck outside the barrier that protects The Vale. She appears before them, introducing herself and explaining who she is. Just as she introduces herself, Sennie collapses in front of her, completely unconscious. Miell expresses concern and offers to help carry Sennie into The Vale. Chryssa chuckles, telling Sennie to get up, only to realize that she truly is unconscious. Miell helps carry Sennie, and ushers Chryssa into The Vale. Chryssa is surprised when they successfully arrive at the lake, informing Miell that they had been unable to reach it and rather getting lost countless times. Miell explains that there is a magical barrier around The Vale to keep intruders out, and help protect The Vale. Chryssa enters the lake, along with her companion Jell, rehydrating herself.

Some time later, Sennie awakens, explaining that a “monster had attacked them.” Miell chuckled, informing them that the “monster” was just a peaceful inhabitant of The Vale, and that they “express themselves differently.” Sennie brushes this off sarcastically, and Miell explains to her who she is. Miell also expresses excitement over the return of humans to Aimyhr. She informs Sennie that she hopes to “once more establish amiable contact with humans.” Miell also expresses that she wishes to continue the ancient “academic traditions with the humans.” Miell makes it clear that Aimyhr heals, slowly but surely.

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content:
- Miell seems to have taken Zeruiah’s place as the guardian of The Vale, as well as bearing great resemblance to Zeruiah both in physical appearance and attitude. This would make Miell one of the four legendary protectors of Aimyhr, the Tetra Arcadia (including Juno-Seto, N'an-Wang-Mu, and Tsovinar), which gives rise to the possibility that the Tetra Arcadia have been replaced.
- Miell refers to “ancient academic traditions,” which most likely refers to the trade of knowledge between humans and Fae during the ancient days of Aimyhr.

'''Miell''' is a Non-Playable Character (NPC) in the Aimyhr storyline.

==In-game Appearance==
Miell is an NPC from the Brave Frontier 2019 Summer Vortex Dungeon. She appears alongside [[Chryssa (character)|Chryssa]] and [[Sennie (character)|Sennie]].

==General==
Miell is a half-fawn, half-human female. She refers to herself as the “caretaker” of The Vale. She seems to be very outgoing, and willing to help any creature in need.

This would make Miell one of the four legendary protectors of Aimyhr, the Tetra Arcadia (including [[Juno-Seto (character)|Juno-Seto]], [[N'an-Wang-Mu (character)|N'an-Wang-Mu]], and [[Tsovinar (character)|Tsovinar]]), which gives rise to the possibility that the Tetra Arcadia have been replaced.
